name: RYSE Center (youth membership and paid internships)
what_you_do: Free youth center with arts, health, organizing and career programs, and paid seasonal internships for members.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 13 to 21. Membership is free.
pay_detail: Membership free; internships are paid (rate not posted)
deadline_text: Membership: join at an enrollment session. Cohorts and internships have separate windows (see notes).
how_to_apply: Register for an enrollment session at rysecenter.org/for-youth, then watch each cohort's application. Phone (510) 374-3401.
notes: Per the cohort page: Food Justice, Public Health, Health and Wellness Career Exploration and STAY FLY TAY Law applications are listed as releasing December 2026; Mock Trial January 2027; Roots to RYSE (summer) Spring 2027; YOUTHBRIDGE internship May 2027. Pay and ages for each cohort are not stated.
